notes:
BLOCKED (HELPER_MISSING) on the missing acknowledged stop for the only effectful ROS command surface. Last gate run 2026-11-05T07:16:20Z, backend fake, report digest sha256:4efe7a740bbca97870822e1c8e202aeb09da72fe4e9aa7a37feb4ab90c357760: G1 pass Layout and isolation; G2 pass Lock; G3 pass Strict resolve; G4 pass Provenance; G5 pass Reference; G6 fail Behaviour with error G6.ESTOP_FAILED: mhs.safety.estop: status failed, MHS.SAFETY.SAFE_STATE_UNREACHED: the device reports that its safe state was not reached; the latch stays engaged; retrying in the background (estop 'engaged', expected engaged or software_only); G7 pass Native surface; G8 warn Protocol and surface (G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE, expected because this package declares no numeric limits); G9 skip Repository tests (G9.NOT_RUN because G6 failed). G8 itself did not fail.

WHAT WAS AUTHORED: a configuration-only RosDriver for the pinned STDR ROS 1 environment interface: /stdr_server/spawn_robot (stdr_msgs/SpawnRobotAction, ros1-actionlib) and a latched /stdr_server/active_robots observation of stdr_msgs/RobotIndexedVectorMsg. The active list is also the read-only robots resource field, so a spawn changes the observable resource state. The fake is a ROS-free RecordingRosTransport; it answers the actionlib goal/result/status traffic and the latched observation, runs no STDR server, nodelet, map, physics or sensor, and is F0. Every endpoint and type cites the pinned clone at 1bcdec7b79c9e4a2960f7fcf9c150c67485ecab4; the model-reviewed lock keeps reviewed_by null. No ROS graph, simulator or hardware was contacted. The spawn input is the complete stdr_msgs/RobotMsg as an open object because the upstream message has many optional sensor arrays.

WHY THE HELPER CANNOT COMPLETE THIS SURFACE: the stock RosDriver bridge reports safe_state.achieved=false for an effectful service/action when no acknowledged stop binding or safe-state Action is declared (docs/ros-driver.md, 'Success and stopping'), so mhs.safety.estop returns MHS.SAFETY.SAFE_STATE_UNREACHED even in simulated mode. The upstream stdr_server advertises no pause, resume, reset or stop service or action: the only services in Server::Server are load_static_map, load_static_map_external and the add/delete rfid, co2, thermal and sound source services (stdr_server/src/stdr_server.cpp:58-140), and the only action servers are spawn_robot, register_robot and delete_robot (stdr_server/src/stdr_server.cpp:31-38), started by activateActionServers (stdr_server/src/stdr_server.cpp:601-605). The robot nodelet advertises only the relative <name>/replace MoveRobot service (stdr_robot/src/stdr_robot.cpp:60-61); its callback rejects a colliding or unknown-occupancy pose and otherwise sets the current pose (stdr_robot/src/stdr_robot.cpp:194-209), so it is a teleport, not a stop. A spawn goal runs addNewRobot synchronously and waits up to 5.0 s for the robot nodelet to register (stdr_server/src/stdr_server.cpp:614-650); its callback checks no preempt request, so an actionlib cancel is not sensed quiescence either. No zero-velocity publication or delete request can honestly serve as the independent stop, and no safe-state Action was fabricated.

SCOPE GAP DISCLOSED: /stdr_server/delete_robot is described by the upstream facts but is not bound, because binding it would add a second effectful action with the same missing stop. /stdr_server/register_robot is the robot-side handshake and is not an operator command. The package also does not bind robot velocity, stepping, pause, map load, sensor streams or reset; the active robot list is the only environment state observed through the resource.

This is fake contract evidence only (contract_checked at F0), not a real ROS or hardware run, and not a safety certification.

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-11-05; reviewed_by stays null): Confirmed the author's block: the pinned ROS 1 server advertises only the load-map and RFID/CO2/thermal/sound source services and the spawn, register and delete actionlib servers (stdr_server.cpp:31-38, 58-140), the robot nodelet only a <name>/replace teleport service and a cmd_vel subscription (stdr_robot.cpp:60-61, motion_controller_base.h:204-208), and no file in the clone offers a pause, reset or stop, so the effectful spawn action leaves the stock e-stop at G6.ESTOP_FAILED with the latch held, which is the honest outcome (HELPER_MISSING, the mvsim precedent). The spawn and active_robots bindings, the ROS 1 actionlib wrapper shapes of the fake (Header.seq, stamp secs/nsecs, status 3 and 4) and the empty-message success predicate match the source. Imprecisions left for the next author: the facts citing stdr_server.cpp:50-63 and 58-140 claim the load-map callbacks and activateActionServers, which are at 467-500 and 601-605; the fact citing 636-650 adds the abort that is on 537; the fact citing stdr_robot.cpp:194-209 ends with the judgement 'it is not a stop'; the comment on _SPAWN_REF resolves the relative name under the node name, whereas the public _nh (stdr_server.h:314) resolves it in the node's namespace; the fake echoes the spawn description unchanged although addNewRobot sets an empty kinematicModel.type to ideal (621-624), which a test asserts; and the robots resource reads the latched active_robots topic, which the server first publishes after a successful spawn or delete (533, 560), so a probe with that topic silent showed mhs.resource.read failing NOT_READY after 2 s and the first spawn waiting 2 s, while the fake answers at once with an empty list. The reviewer changed no authored file; the gate re-run rewrote check-report.json with the same findings. For the human reviewer: STDR robot motion is an unacknowledged cmd_vel subscription per robot; a velocity capability would have no stop either. Unblocking needs an acknowledged pause or stop in the simulator, or an SDK route that accepts an R0 simulator effect without one.
